reward: terminal HV(policy) minus terminal HV(frozen shared greedy), same training instance/algorithm seed/scenarios; frozen training normalization
advantage: paired terminal return minus old critic, standardized per component with equal episode weights, fixed for this update
weighting: each optimizer step averages I/C/M losses equally; episodes are sampled equally within each component
critic: value head learns paired terminal return; critic gradient does not modify shared actor representation
tuning: first validation instance of each S0/S4/S8, all three existing validation seeds, greedy deployment
confirmation: second validation instance of each S0/S4/S8, same three seeds; chosen nonzero checkpoint evaluated greedy and sampled; sampled u0 control
selection: configuration-equal paired final HV delta on tuning; record both overall best including u0 and best nonzero checkpoint; evaluate nonzero regardless of sign
first_preview: two u0 replay checks, six paired training searches, first three tuning comparisons; continue fixed schedule
qualification: Post-hoc development pilot. No screen instances used for fitting or selection. Validation instances have been used in earlier development; confirmation is not a new independent final test. No outcome-driven instance, seed, budget or version changes.
